Key independent verification work:
- Static binary inspection (strings/grep on the real agy 1.1.15 executable) corroborated round 1's live finding that the `tools:` custom-agent allowlist is inert for --agent-selected mainAgents: the binary's own changelog lists supported Markdown-agent frontmatter fields and `tools:` is not among them.
- Live smoke tests against real agy 1.1.15 found the ACTUAL trigger mechanism, which corrects the supervisor ruling's own speculation: it's a nested `ArtifactMetadata` object's presence (captured verbatim: `{"RequestFeedback":bool,"Summary":string,"UserFacing":bool}`), not a boolean `IsArtifact` field as the ruling guessed. I captured two real write_to_file calls to the identical path differing only in whether ArtifactMetadata was present — one failed, one succeeded — giving a deterministic repro (previous rounds thought this was flaky).
- Rewrote the hook (harness/agy/native_write_hook.go) to allow/deny based on ArtifactMetadata-presence-plus-out-of-brain-target, not path alone, fixing the legitimate-write-blocking bug. Found and fixed a real POSIX-sh single-quote escaping bug while doing this (an apostrophe in the new deny-reason text silently broke the generated hook script — caught by executing it via `sh -c`, not just reading the Go source).
- Redesigned the repair-retry (harness/agy/adapter.go RunTurn) to use a fresh agy conversation instead of resuming the failed one, since live testing showed the "sticky conversation-status" defect (result.status stuck at ERROR with a stale message) reproduces WITHIN a single turn now, not just across resumed turns — added sessionState.agyConversationID/resolveConversationID/adoptConversationID so later calls on the same external session ID follow the repaired conversation. Proved this end-to-end with a real (non-mocked) Adapter.CreateSession+RunTurn invocation against live agy that recovered a genuine artifact-path failure transparently.
- Added an optional "layer zero" prompt preamble (supervisor addendum, implemented since it was cheap and I had the correct field name).
- Fixed findings 4 (hooks.json permission-mode widening; now preserves existing file mode) and 5 (added both required init.tools dumps to WORK_SUMMARY.md).
